analogy.rationale: Guanylate cyclase activators raise cGMP, but the annotated target GABBR1 is a GABA-B receptor that these cell lines barely express, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other cyclic-nucleotide pathway modulators (adenylyl cyclase activators, phosphodiesterase inhibitors) and GABA/G-protein-coupled receptor classes.
